typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: 'Pr_GenerateXML_PSD',
	schemaName: 'LETTER',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBPSDOUT
SRCOLEDBPSDOUT derive({Copy of COL_XML} = toString(COL_XML)) ~> DTTDCNVPSDOUT
DTTDCNVPSDOUT sink(input(
		Copy_of_COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Copy_of_COL_XML = {Copy of COL_XML})) ~> DSTFFPSDOUT
